# HealerProtection by D4KiR

## [v1.3.14](https://github.com/d4kir92/HealerProtection/tree/v1.3.14) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/d4kir92/HealerProtection/compare/v1.3.13...v1.3.14) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/d4kir92/HealerProtection/releases)

- v1.3.14  
- Send debug SAY and YELL alerts inside instances  
    - Debug mode really sends SAY and YELL alerts when solo inside an instance  
- Add language dropdown, UI language switch, sidebar and debug command  
    - Chat language is now chosen from one dropdown instead of three checkboxes  
    - Language switch at the top left of the settings  
    - Settings window has a sidebar for quick navigation  
    - /hp debug skips the group and instance checks to test chat messages  
- Match OOM sliders against all spell ranks  
    - OOM and Near-OOM sliders now pick the spell rank closest to the set percentage  
- Skip chat alerts during chat messaging lockdown  
    - Chat alerts are no longer sent while the game blocks addon chat messages

## [v1.3.11](https://github.com/d4kir92/HealerProtection/tree/v1.3.11) (2026-11-20)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/d4kir92/HealerProtection/compare/v1.3.10...v1.3.11) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/d4kir92/HealerProtection/releases)

- v1.3.11  
- Delay OOM alert and tighten aggro detection  
    - OOM alert waits until the three cheapest mana spells are unaffordable  
    - Near-OOM alert now fires before OOM when mana is hidden  
    - Aggro alert only triggers when enemies are actually attacking you  
    - Aggro detection also checks group targets and per-enemy threat
